description: Daily LEVI state backup: snapshot always, sync to encrypted remote when configured. Sync failures are logged and retried next run; the job never crashes.
name: levi-backup-daily
notes: Snapshot always runs, even with no remote configured and even without rclone.
Sync runs only when `levi backup configure --remote NAME` has set a verified crypt remote.
Requires rclone on PATH for the sync leg; install per docs/BACKUP.md (~/bin/rclone is the persistent spot).
timezone_note: Run in the user's local timezone (America/Chicago). 03:00 local keeps it out of the way of the academy's 6-hour training blocks.
